newsitem.title: USA: Omega Healthcare invests in nursing homes.
newsitem.headline: Omega Healthcare invests in nursing homes.

text.p: Omega Healthcare Investors Inc said Wednesday it paid $52.5 million in 11 nursing homes in five states and $5.9 million for a 159-bed facility in Washington State.

The 11 nursing homes in Alabama, Texas, Illinois, Louisiana and Florida have a total of 1,439 beds, Omega Healthcare said. Four partnerships that sold the properties to Omega Healthcare are leasing back the properties for $5.8 million annually, the company said.
Omega Healthcare is a real estate investment trust with a portfolio of 232 health care facilities in 26 states.
Its shares were up 1/8 Wednesday at 31-1/2.
